id: title:gesh:display incomplete intervals in tools calls and errors chart

review.posthog_relevance: Adds theme-specific snapshot entries and an activity tail prop to the analytics dashboard UI, potentially affecting the visualization of in-progress call and error metrics.
review.reason: Adds two snapshot entries for the in-progress bucket, both dark and light themes, and passes an activityIncompleteTail prop to the ActivityChart component. This is a narrow, localized change to the frontend dashboard visualization, not a systemic capability or critical path improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact of the snapshot entries and the activityIncompleteTail prop on the user's interpretation of results is not demonstrated; this could be a minor UI adjustment or a significant behavior change, but the code does not establish the latter.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a review and score, not just observations.
